jobs.description: Job available in 4 locations: Berlin, Halle, Remote, LeipzigWork ScheduleStandard (Mon-Fri)Environmental ConditionsOfficeJob DescriptionJob DescriptionAs part of the Thermo Fisher Scientific team, you’ll discover meaningful work that makes a positive impact on a global scale. Join our colleagues in bringing our Mission to life every single day to enable our customers to make the world healthier, cleaner and safer. We provide our global teams with the resources needed to achieve individual career goals while helping to take science a step beyond by developing solutions for some of the world’s toughest challenges, like protecting the environment, making sure our food is safe or helping find cures for cancer.The Clinical Diagnostics Division (CDD) provides innovative diagnostic solutions across selected in vitro diagnostics (IVD) market segments and has been a trusted partner to the IVD industry for more than 40 years.Our portfolio includes solutions for drugs-of-abuse testing, therapeutic drug monitoring, quality control, sepsis diagnosis, prenatal screening and more. This includes supporting the implementation of biomarker-guided clinical pathways, hospital protocols and antimicrobial stewardship programs, as well as delivering clinical education through discussions, presentations and workshops.What to expect:- Drive clinical demand and adoption of Procalcitonin (PCT) and other innovative biomarkers.- Engage healthcare professionals, clinical users and decision-makers across relevant medical specialties.- Analyze and prioritize accounts with high clinical development potential, identify relevant stakeholders and develop account-specific strategies to increase clinical acceptance and adoption.- Build strong, sustainable relationships with key clinical stakeholders and decision-makers.- Support the implementation of biomarker-guided clinical pathways, hospital protocols and antimicrobial stewardship programs.- Deliver clinical education through discussions, presentations and workshops.- Develop account strategies together with our License Partners, align clinical development activities and support joint customer activities where appropriate.- Act as a scientific and clinical partner and actively drive market development without direct sales responsibility.- Work closely with Medical Affairs, Marketing and other Commercial teams.- Represent Thermo Fisher Scientific at relevant events and scientific congresses.- Contribute to territory growth through increased clinical adoption and systematic account development.Ensure complete and up-to-date documentation of relevant account and activity information in Salesforce (SFDC).Keys to Success:Education- Bachelor’s degree in Life Sciences, Chemistry, Biology or a related scientific field; an advanced scientific or clinical degree is an advantage.Experience- 3+ years of relevant experience in healthcare, diagnostics or a related environment.- Experience in in vitro diagnostics, biomarkers, or clinical areas such as Critical Care, Infectious Diseases, Emergency Medicine, sepsis or Antimicrobial Stewardship is an advantage.- Experience engaging clinical users and healthcare decision-makers.Knowledge, Skills, Abilities- Ability to understand and communicate scientific and clinical content.- Strong communication, presentation and stakeholder management skills.- Confident and persuasive engagement with medical decision-makers at different seniority levels, with the ability to conduct credible clinical discussions, constructively challenge established approaches and initiate change.- Strong analytical and organizational capabilities.- Strong initiative, influencing skills and results orientation, with the ability to identify clinical development opportunities early and systematically advance them.- Ability to build lasting relationships with clinical stakeholders and business partners.- Ability to work independently and effectively in a cross-functional matrix organization.- Proficiency with CRM systems, preferably Salesforce, and Microsoft Office.- Valid driver’s license and willingness to travel extensively within the assigned territory (>50%).- Fluent German and strong English communication skills.Benefits:We offer competitive remuneration, annual incentive plan bonus, healthcare, and a range of employee benefits. Thermo Fisher Scientific offers employment with an innovative, forward-thinking organization, and outstanding career and development prospects. We offer an exciting company culture that stands for integrity, intensity, involvement, and innovation!Our Mission is to enable our customers to make the world healthier, cleaner and safer. Watch as our colleagues explain 5 reasons to work with us. As one team of 100,000+ colleagues, we share a common set of values - Integrity, Intensity, Innovation and Involvement - working together to accelerate research, solve complex scientific challenges, drive technological innovation and support patients in need.#StartYourStory at Thermo Fisher Scientific, where diverse experiences, backgrounds and perspectives are valued.Apply today! http://jobs.thermofisher.com (http://jobs.thermofisher.com/)Thermo Fisher Scientific is an EEO/Affirmative Action Employer and does not discriminate on the basis of  , color, religion, ___ ,   orientation, gender identity, national origin, protected veteran status, disability or any other legally protected status.

jobs.description: We are looking for an (Senior) Analyst to join our Transactions Team in Berlin. In this hands-on investment role, you will support acquisitions, disposals, and joint ventures across office, hotel, residential/BTR, logistics, and development assets. Working closely with Senior Transaction Managers and the Co-Head of Transactions, you will be involved in underwriting, financial modelling, due diligence, transaction execution, and investment analysis across Germany and selected international markets. Location: Berlin Your Tasks Transaction Execution & Management Support the full deal lifecycle on acquisitions and disposals across Germany and international markets, covering office, hotel, residential, logistics, and development assets. Prepare financial models, DCF analyses, and business plans for standing assets and development projects; stress-test assumptions and evaluate investment scenarios. Drafting or assisting with drafting and review Letters of Intent (LOIs), term sheets, and other transaction documents. Coordinate and manage due diligence workstreams, including data room management, adviser coordination, and cross-departmental communication. Support signing and closing management, including CP tracking and condition satisfaction. Investment Analysis & Underwriting Screen, evaluate, and underwrite incoming acquisition opportunities across target asset classes and geographies. Prepare investment memoranda, board presentations, and transaction approval documents that clearly communicate financial metrics, investment thesis, and risk/return profile. Develop and maintain financial models (excel-based) for both stabilised assets and value-add / development opportunities; produce Key Metric Summaries. Conduct in-depth feasibility analysis for repositioning, conversion, and development scenarios. Market Research & Deal Origination Conduct comprehensive market research on target real estate sub-markets, including supply/demand dynamics, rental trends, yield movements, and competitive landscape. Build and maintain deal flow tracking tools and acquisition pipeline databases (CRM). (Support) Deal-sourcing efforts through broker engagement, market intelligence, and investment screening. Participate in meetings with brokers, institutional investors, JV partners, and other stakeholders. Your Profile Education & Experience Degree in Business Administration, Real Estate Management, Finance, Economics, or Engineering; MRICS / master's-level qualification a plus. At least two years of professional experience in real estate investment, private equity (real estate), M&A, asset management, valuation, or brokerage. Track record of financial modelling and investment analysis across European real estate markets; experience with development projects is an advantage. Technical Skills Advanced Excel skills, including dynamic financial models, DCF / IRR analysis, and scenario modelling -- proficiency is non-negotiable. Strong PowerPoint skills; ability to produce clear, concise investment presentations and board materials. Hands-on experience with AI tools (e.g. large language models, AI-assisted research, prompt engineering) and/or CRM / deal management platforms is a strong advantage. Familiarity with data room platforms (e.g. Drooms, Intralinks, Datasite) is a plus. Competencies & Personal Profile Strong quantitative and analytical thinking -- able to cut through complexity and build conviction on investment cases. Self-starter with high initiative, ownership mentality, and the ability to manage multiple work streams simultaneously in a fast-paced deal environment. Excellent written and verbal communication skills -- ability to present financial analysis and investment logic concisely to senior stakeholders. Meticulous attention to detail, reliability, and a strong sense of accountability. Collaborative team player with a growth mindset and an appetite for continuous learning. Languages: Excellent English (written and spoken) required; fluent German is a strong plus and highly preferred for the German market. Your Perspective Attractive remuneration package Significant scope for professional development and accelerated career progression within a large, institutionally led real estate platform. Deep cross-asset-class exposure: office, hotel, residential/BTR, retail, and development. wet-lab scientists (including collaborations at MDC / BIMSB and DKTK sites)Application of a wide range of methodologies: single-cell and spatial transcriptomics, RNA sequencing, multiplex imaging,
